paragraphs.text: Warrior is a creature type . Warriors are combatants who fight alone or in loose hordes.

Unlike soldiers , whose strength is in their numbers, a single warrior is often content to take on the world all by themselves. Warriors favor brute strength over cunning and sheer will over tactics. Many warriors have trample .

The first card to feature the type was Cat Warriors from Legends . At the time Cat Warriors was its own creature type until it was cleaned up in Sixth Edition . Retroactively, many cards like Dwarven Warriors , Goblin Balloon Brigade and Orcish Artillery from Alpha gained the type, as well. Most warriors are black , red , or green . However, some worlds have White warriors, such as Amonkhet , Tarkir , Kaldheim and Zendikar specifically in Zendikar Rising .
Warriors are part of the party batching mechanic introduced in Zendikar Rising .

Morningtide featured Obsidian Battle-Axe , a kindred equipment that equips for free on Warriors if they just have entered the battlefield.
Lovisa Coldeyes gives all Warriors +2/+2 and Haste.
Brighthearth Banneret makes Warrior spells cheaper to cast.
Chief of the Edge and Chief of the Scale give +1/+0 and +0/+1, respectively.
Herald of Dromoka gives Warriors Vigilance .
Kor Blademaster gives equipped Warriors double strike .
Ghitu Encampment (2/1 red Warrior with First Strike)

In the Grand Creature Type Update the subtype Stangg Twin for a token created by Stangg was changed into a (Human) Warrior token "named Stangg Twin". The subtypes Raider ( Erg Raiders ) and War-Rider ( Varchild's War-Riders ) were incorporated into the Warrior class as well.
